title: contacts-client: address_book_set drops AddressBookSetParams.extra
description: crate-jmap-contacts-client/src/methods/addressbook.rs address_book_set copies only on_destroy_remove_contents and on_success_set_is_default from params; params.extra never reaches the wire. Violates workspace AGENTS.md extras-preservation policy (method-argument structs in *-client crates must route extra onto the wire). Fix: merge p.extra into args with entry().or_insert() after the typed fields, as mailbox_set / calendar_set do; add a wiremock test asserting a vendor acmeCorp* key appears in the request body. Found while fixing JMAP-tjvm.38.
